class.name: CgameTerrainSplines
class.brief_description: Spline helpers for roads, rivers, bridges and landscape deformation.
class.description: [CgameTerrainSplines] is a native port of the GDScript [code]terrain_splines.gd[/code] library. All methods are static. Heights are indexed [code]y * width + x[/code]; the world position of a cell is [code](x, y) * cell_size[/code] on the XZ plane ([member Vector3.x], [member Vector3.z]) and the spline height is [member Vector3.y]. [method deform] deforms the terrain around a spline (flatten for roads, carve for rivers, raise for embankments) and is evaluated row by row on the [WorkerThreadPool] for large maps. [method bridge_spans] finds the stretches of a spline that float above the terrain and therefore need a bridge.

method.name: bridge_spans
method.description: Returns the inclusive index ranges of [param spline] samples that float more than [param clearance] above the terrain. Every entry is a [Dictionary] with the integer keys [code]start[/code] and [code]end[/code].

method.name: catmull_rom
method.description: Returns a uniform Catmull-Rom spline through all [param points] (the end points are duplicated). The result contains every control point exactly and has [code](points.size() - 1) * samples_per_segment + 1[/code] samples. With fewer than two points the input is returned.

method.name: deform
method.description: Returns a deformed copy of [param heights]. [param mode] is [code]"flatten"[/code] (blend toward the spline height), [code]"carve"[/code] (lower a channel 1.0 below the spline with smooth banks) or [code]"raise"[/code] (only lift terrain up to the spline height). The effect is full within [param half_width] and fades out smoothly over the next [param falloff] units. Unknown modes leave the terrain unchanged.

method.name: distance_to_polyline
method.description: Returns the distance from [param point] to the closest point of [param polyline], or infinity for an empty polyline.
